professionalSummary.text: Built Kotlin services behind regulated open-banking endpoints including account-balances and transactions-history endpoints, implementing pagination, consent checks, and error code mapping to the standard.
professionalSummary.witness: Built the Kotlin service behind the account-balances endpoint at Harrowgate Building Society, including pagination, consent checks and mapping of internal errors to the standard's error codes.

professionalSummary.text: Maintained conformance test suite against open-banking standard, adding test cases for variable recurring payments consent flow.
professionalSummary.witness: Kept the conformance test suite passing against each new version of the open-banking standard and added test cases for the variable recurring payments consent flow.

professionalSummary.text: Achieved measurable response-time improvement on transactions-history endpoint by replacing per-row consent lookup with cached consent snapshot, with baseline comparison documented in gateway performance report.
professionalSummary.witness: Profiled the transactions-history endpoint and replaced a per-row consent lookup with a cached consent snapshot, then worked with the API gateway team to compare response times before and after the change.

professionalSummary.text: Collaborated with security team on quarterly certificate rotation for third-party connections, updating trust-store configuration and verifying handshake logs.
professionalSummary.witness: Joined the quarterly certificate rotation with the security team, updating the trust-store configuration for third-party provider connections and checking the handshake logs afterwards.

professionalSummary.text: Holds Oracle Certified Professional: Java SE 17 Developer certification, verified by vendor's certification verification page.
professionalSummary.witness: the candidate's Oracle Certified Professional: Java SE 17 Developer credential was looked up on the vendor's certification verification page with the validation number the candidate supplied; it is listed as earned in May 2023.

experienceHighlights.text: Account-balances endpoint service implementation with full compliance to open-banking standard including error code mapping and consent checks.
experienceHighlights.witness: Built the Kotlin service behind the account-balances endpoint at Harrowgate Building Society, including pagination, consent checks and mapping of internal errors to the standard's error codes.

experienceHighlights.text: Conformance test suite maintenance with addition of test cases for variable recurring payments consent flow.
experienceHighlights.witness: Kept the conformance test suite passing against each new version of the open-banking standard and added test cases for the variable recurring payments consent flow.

experienceHighlights.text: Response-time improvement on transactions-history endpoint through cache optimization, with documented baseline comparison.
experienceHighlights.witness: Profiled the transactions-history endpoint and replaced a per-row consent lookup with a cached consent snapshot, then worked with the API gateway team to compare response times before and after the change.

experienceHighlights.text: Certificate rotation process execution with security team, including trust-store configuration updates and handshake log verification.
experienceHighlights.witness: Joined the quarterly certificate rotation with the security team, updating the trust-store configuration for third-party provider connections and checking the handshake logs afterwards.
